fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: A quick stab that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Hidden Edge
fusions.desc: Throws a concealed blade up to 7 tiles for 28 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full range. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Feigned Grooming
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Edge Unseen
fusions.desc: After 12 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
